recommendation_reason: Rewrite B (qwen2.5:14b) directly addresses the job's requirements by emphasizing hands-on technical support, basic computer repair, and customer service—key skills listed in the job description. It includes a tailored 'Technical Support Volunteer' role that mirrors the job’s focus on virus clean-ups, Windows troubleshooting, and hardware upgrades. Unlike Rewrite A (phi4), which retained irrelevant cloud engineering expertise and dropped critical quantitative achievements (per fact-check), Rewrite B aligns with the job’s practical, non-certification-based requirements. Its fact-check status (no fallback, accurate alignment) further validates its suitability.

career_roadmap.step: Apply for the role with Rewrite B
career_roadmap.action: Submit the qwen2.5:14b version of the CV to the Computer Repair Technician position, emphasizing the volunteer technical support experience and practical repair skills.
Enroll in a CompTIA A+ or similar certification program to bridge the gap between current data science expertise and the hardware-focused demands of the role.
Target roles such as Help Desk Technician or IT Support Specialist to gain hands-on experience with customer-facing technical problem-solving and hardware maintenance.
Transition to specialized roles like Field Service Technician or IT Hardware Repair Specialist, leveraging both technical certifications and practical experience.
